d:
Prabhat khabar ne shukravar jharkhand maining end miniral konklev ka aayojan karvaya. is konklev ka hissa banne tata stil, bisisiel, sisiel samet jharkhand ughog jagat ki kaee kapniyan shamil huee. aayojan men mukhy atithi ke taur par jharkhand sarkar men vitt mantri radha krishn kishor shamil hue. is dauran khanan evan udyog sachiv arva raj kamal bhi maujud rahen.
